title: Local Delivery Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: Set the local delivery inspection scope, test readiness and requirement-level evidence, contain deficiencies, authorize status, and preserve qualified closeout.
description: An original, fillable local delivery inspection checklist form for controlling multi-stop local order through inspection checklist identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use when a route dispatcher or qualified inspector must evaluate multi-stop local order against the route plan, customer order, and package labels and provide a traceable basis for release, restriction, hold, correction, or rejection.

sections.title: Local Delivery inspection checklist identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

blocks.label: Responsible parties and route points

fields.label: Origin store, hub, or pickup point
Delivery address and stop access point

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the route plan, customer order, and package labels.

sections.title: Local Delivery inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Define the exact population and review basis so inspection conclusions remain bounded.

fields.label: Route Plan, Customer Order, And Package Labels

blocks.label: Local Delivery readiness verification
items: Stop sequence matches promised delivery windows and traffic constraints
Every order is matched to route, stop, package, and recipient identifiers
Vehicle capacity and package placement support the planned stop sequence
Driver has access instructions, contact method, and failed-attempt rules
Age, identity, signature, or photo requirements are explicit where applicable
Fragile, upright, temperature, and no-unattended-delivery controls are visible
Returns, exchanges, cash handling, or reusable containers have separate custody
Dispatcher has a communication and escalation path for route disruption
blocks.guidance: A failed readiness item must be resolved, excluded with rationale, or carried into the exception section.

sections.title: Local Delivery requirement-level inspection results
sections.guidance: Record actual observations against explicit criteria and identify the evidence for each result.

blocks.label: Local Delivery detailed inspection points
items: Route label and customer order identify the same stop and recipient
Piece count agrees with the staged order and driver manifest
Packaging is closed, dry, stable, and free of visible crushing or puncture
Fragile and orientation markings remain legible and correctly placed
Time-window and contact-on-arrival instructions are available to the driver
Address, unit, gate, loading zone, and parking details are complete
Restricted-delivery and unattended-drop rules are understood
Return goods and reusable assets are segregated from outbound orders
Proof method can be captured without exposing unrelated customer information
Unresolved count, label, condition, or access issue is held before departure
blocks.guidance: Checkboxes indicate that the point was examined; the result table carries findings and evidence.

sections.title: Local Delivery measurements and evidence package
sections.guidance: Preserve readings, instruments, identity, and evidence needed to reproduce the inspection decision.

blocks.label: Measurement, count, or verification log
blocks.guidance: Use the method applicable to Expected and delivered pieces and Package and product condition.

blocks.label: Available inspection evidence
items: Route assignment and stop sequence snapshot
Package or tote scan at load
Departure and arrival timestamp
Recipient name or authorized delivery point
Delivery photo or signature reference
Failed-attempt contact record
Shortage, damage, or return image reference
Driver and dispatcher communication reference

blocks.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

fields.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

sections.title: Local Delivery exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Local Delivery exception indicators
items: Address or access point cannot be located
Recipient unavailable or refuses delivery
Package is missing, extra, mislabeled, or assigned to another stop
Packaging or contents show visible damage or leakage
Delivery window will be missed
Identity, signature, or age condition cannot be completed
Unsafe parking, property condition, animal, or other site hazard
Customer requests an unapproved alternate delivery location
Proof capture fails or conflicts with the delivered stop
Return item or reusable container cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Local Delivery inspection status and release decision
sections.guidance: Do not turn a checklist score into release when a critical exception or evidence gap remains.

sections.title: Local Delivery inspection checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: Use this local delivery inspection checklist with the applicable customer commitment, carrier terms, site policy, and retention requirements. Do not infer acceptance or release from a signature alone; unresolved identity, count, condition, custody, or proof issues require an owner, escalation, and documented disposition.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by local delivery operations lead

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
